arguments.command:
$rev="E:\项目_手动重构\build\final-hone-dh1b_5mf\project\workspace\cooperation\8e577bfc8472\reviews\7aa1b917-3373-4cbe-b708-bf0eaf8dfd50\source"
$main="E:\项目_手动重构\build\final-hone-dh1b_5mf\project\workspace\cooperation\8e577bfc8472\main"
$tracked = git -C $main ls-files
$diff=0
foreach($rel in $tracked){
  $a=Join-Path $main $rel; $b=Join-Path $rev $rel
  if(-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $b)){ Write-Host "MISSING-IN-CANDIDATE $rel"; $diff++; continue }
  if((Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $a).Hash -ne (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $b).Hash){ Write-Host "DIFF $rel"; $diff++ }
}
Write-Host "tracked files in main: $($tracked.Count); mismatches in candidate: $diff"
Write-Host "--- candidate tracked-deliverable spot check ---"
foreach($rel in 'hone/hone.py','hone/utils/csv_utils.py','hone/__main__.py','pyproject.toml','README.md','dist/hone-0.1.0-py3-none-any.whl','tests/test_packaging.py','scripts/verify_acceptance.py'){ Write-Host "$rel : $(Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $rev $rel))" }
Write-Host "--- run unittest inside candidate source ---"
$env:PYTHONPATH=''
Push-Location $rev
$env:PYTHONPATH=(Resolve-Path .).Path
python -m unittest discover -s tests -t . 2>&1 | Select-Object -Last 4
Remove-Item Env:PYTHONPATH
Pop-Location
